scope: Theorem 4.3 (Uniform finite-rank decay) of the manuscript “The cotype–cotype conjecture under the approximation property” (preprints/The-cotype-cotype-conjecture-under-the-approximation-property-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 326 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c2f55fe9562e2ee7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix m, Dg, Df satisfying the assumptions of Lemma 4.2. There is an integer n0, depending only on these parameters, such that every finite-rank T : G → F with cm(G∗) ≤ Dg and cm(F) ≤ Df satisfies wn(T) ≤ 1 2wn−2m(T) (n ≥ n0). (4.10) In particular there are numbers ρN → 0, independent of G, F, T, such that wN (T) ≤ ρN ∥T∥. (4.11) Both bounds also hold for every T : G → F that is an operator-norm limit of finite-rank maps, under the same moment hypotheses on G∗ and F.
